comment: Live spectrum analyzer on the pedal screen (MS-70CDR 2.10). Pass-through; a 1024-point FFT of (L+R)/2 drawn as 126 log-spaced bars (40 Hz - 16 kHz) with peak hold, at up to ~30 fps. On zvis (src/custom/common/zvis.h).

params.name: Range
params.comment: Shown range below 0 dBFS: 30 to 90 dB (default 60).

params.name: Tilt
params.comment: Lift the highs: 0 to 6 dB per octave around 1 kHz (default 3, so pink noise reads flat).
